title: gno.land upgrade ledger
description: Every binary a gno.land network has run, in chain order. A version runs the blocks from the previous entry's halt_height + 1 (1 for genesis) up to and including the next entry's halt_height. The authoritative rules are in gno.land/pkg/upgrades (Go); this schema documents the shape for third-party readers.

genesis_sha256.description: sha256 of the genesis.json on the chain/<name> release

kind.description: genesis: the first entry only, no halt. upgrade: activated by a coordinated halt.

version.description: the release tag compiled into the binary; a testnet may run a pre-release

halt_height.description: the halt that activated this version; null for genesis

halt_time.description: block time of the halt block; null until the halt has happened

halt_min_version.description: the floor the proposal set; null when it set none (never the empty string)

digest.description: null until CI has built the image

binaries.description: os/arch → download URL with a ?checksum=sha256:<hex> suffix (the cosmovisor convention)

ran_as.description: the image digest the network actually ran when it differs from image.digest (versions tagged after the fact)

release.description: the vX.Y.Z release page: binaries, checksums, changelog
